title: Web3 Checkout
tagline: Trusted easy-to-setup cross-border checkout page that allows developers accept crypto payments with ease.
description:
There are many difficulties accepting payment with crypto. We've made a solution that allows for developers to integrate web3 payments easily into their already great store or application.

You worry about what you sell, we make sure you're getting your time worth.

The service allows merchants to create products and accept payments for them easily, and provides a simple interface for customers that provides trust through verified reviews.

For the merchant to easily improve their product, there is an AI that will take key points from the reviews and compile it into an awesome summarized text.
how_its_made: To start, we used Node.js with Next.JS and Postgres for our basic stack. Specifically, we used WalletConnect AppKit for users to sign in with their wallet. We aimed to use WorldCoin to provide trusted feedback to customers and to make sure purchases can be limited to a single human person. For our currency, we decided on Circle's USDC because of it's stability, a great track record and users' familiarity with the American dollar. And, last but not least, we used ENS to resolve addresses all over the app for a better user experience.
